extraction_fields.instruction: Does the bidder itself state that it holds an Ontario electrical contractor licence?
The licence number as written (e.g. ECRA/ESA number).
Does the proposal confirm current WSIB clearance?
Amount of commercial general liability insurance stated, in CAD.
Number of commercial solar installations of 100 kW or more completed in the 5 years before the evaluation date. Use "ambiguous" if the stated period starts before that window.
Total price in CAD. Note in notes if anything (permits, utility connection) is excluded.
Committed time from award to completion, in weeks. Null if not committed.
Is a specific project lead named or identified now (not "to be assigned")?
Is the crew size or make-up stated?
Is a site safety plan included?
Is ongoing performance monitoring of the installed system offered? Project progress reports alone do not count.

mandatory.label: Ontario electrical contractor licence held by the bidder

weighted.note: Commercial installs >= 100 kW within the last 5 years
Full marks at 70% of ceiling or less, zero at the ceiling
Full marks at 8 weeks or less, zero at 16 weeks; missing = 0
Each item worth an equal share
